about: Daily routines of the real people of data/people.json who can be in the Walled City in the week Tue 16 - Mon 22 Dec 1986. Each slot gives a place (at) and an activity (doing). A gap in the week means home. For a person with home null, a gap means out (outside the City). basis "sourced" means that the source gives the activity and the hour. basis "inferred" means that the model chose the hour or the place. A unit key is "b:k:u" (building, floor, unit). "roof:<b>" is a roof, and "route:A->B" is a walk from A to B. "round:post" is the post round, and "lanes" is a walk in the alleys. "to" 24:00 is the end of the day. home_basis or work_basis "inferred" means that the model chose the unit. figure.sex is "m" or "f"; null means that no source shows it. Mon 22 Dec 1986 is 冬至 (Dongzhi).
